test_cython_weighted_fenwick_tree: test the Cython weighted Fenwick tree implementation with random seeds and cumulative weight queries
create_PytestWeightedFenwickTree: create a PytestWeightedFenwickTree instance with a given size for weighted cumulative aggregation
